description.en: Rides a rocket towards your defence and lands on contacting.
description.zh: 骑着火箭径直冲向你的防线，碰到植物时落地。

chat.en: He walks fast enough without a rocket, but you know, Imps just dislike regular entrance.
chat.zh: 他不依靠火箭前进速度已经够快了，但是你懂的，小鬼僵尸很不喜欢以平庸的方式入场。

text.en: strikes into you lawn until blocked by a plant
text.zh: 突然冲进你的草坪，直到被植物挡住

text.en: chilly attacks force him to land, then fire attacks launch him away
text.zh: 火箭会被冷冻攻击打断，再被火焰攻击点燃时直接离场
